summary: FD_TC_163_Not Eligible | ASL | Travel Completed | Both MSL and Arrival Delay Below 8hrs (and Below 3hrs) | Single Pax | 2 Legs
title: Not Eligible | ASL | Travel Completed | Both MSL and Arrival Delay Below 8hrs (and Below 3hrs) | Single Pax | 2 Legs
description:
Israel-destination multi-leg (YYZ?FRA?TLV). BOTH the MSL delay (2hrs on Leg 1) AND the final arrival delay (1.5hrs at TLV) are below the 8-hour ASL Travel Completed threshold (and also below the 3hr No Travel threshold). This is the simplest "below threshold" NE scenario � no ambiguity, no recovered delay, just insufficient delay everywhere. Paired with TC_146 (NE-22, where MSL was above 3hr but arrival was below 8hr) to show the distinction

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger Shai Benvenisti (Adult). Journey: 2 legs: Leg 1 AC 873 YYZ?FRA (delayed 2hrs, arrival delay code 42 � Not Extraordinary Circumstance); Leg 2 AC 9042 FRA?TLV (on time). Promise: Final arrival TLV = 18:00. Actual: Final arrival TLV = 19:30 (1.5hr delay). MSL: Leg 1 (2hr delay). Final destination delay: 1.5hrs. Both below 8hr ASL Travel Completed threshold (and also below 3hr). Regime: ASL (Israel destination � TLV) + APPR. Result: NOT ELIGIBLE (both MSL and arrival delay below all applicable thresholds).
